messages:
anya: Thanks for coming to the all-hands Q&A. I'm posting quick clarifications and action items here. Reply if you spot errors.
kevin: Quick headline: comp cycle stays Nov for main increases; we will keep the mid-cycle spot check in May for alignment.
julia: Can folks request off-cycle promotions if retention risk?
anya: Yes. Off-cycle/expedited promos allowed for retention or new role necessity. Flow: manager submits proposal -> director endorsement -> People Ops quick review. Well publish an expedited form. ETA: draft this week.
tom: Would equity refreshes be on the table for off-cycle cases?
kevin: Typically no for ad-hoc promos unless approved by Finance for high-risk retention cases. Managers should flag requests early.
julia: Benefits question: any changes to parental leave or flexibility policies? Lots of folks asked at the Q.
anya: No policy changes this fiscal year. Were running an employee benefits survey and exploring options long-term. Please complete the survey when it lands.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: people-ops/benefits-survey opens Mon 09:00 PT. Link will be posted.
tom: For leveling rubric updates: can we get concrete example narratives that managers can adapt?
kevin: Yes 1 examples per transition and a short checklist will be added to the manager packet.
julia: Is there a single one-pager on comp cadence for interview loops and new hire comms?
anya: We will publish a 'Comp & Promotions at Redwood' one-pager in the handbook and share with hiring managers. Target publish date: next Fri.
tom: How are exceptions logged for audit?
kevin: Expedited cases tracked in a shared sheet, approvals attached in Workday, audit copies retained by People Ops.
julia: Thanks, this helps.
anya: If anyone needs an intake call for a specific case, DM me or schedule via my calendar. Closing once the one-pager and form are live.
